Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Balamb Garden
Description: Gardening companion: stand by your garden and water, harvest, or replant a whole patch - or every ripe pot in the house - with one button, at a patient human pace. Keeps a ledger of what's planted where, when you watered it, and when it will be ripe (down to the afternoon). Tips watch your crossbreed pipelines and say when a chain is about to starve. /garden to open.
Changelog: Household sync is here: type your shared garden phrase in the settings (both installs, same phrase) and the plugin quietly shares watering and harvest news between you. If someone else in the house watered a bed, its hover says so - 'watered 2:05pm - external' - so nobody double-waters and nothing gets missed. No accounts, no setup beyond the phrase; leave it empty and the plugin never touches the network. Also: the time-remaining estimate in the run window now settles instead of sawtoothing.
